T10.method: Source review: header uses blocking s_in.read(); generated sample-lane reader calls streamutils::read_axi4_word, whose boundary reader uses s.read(). No timeout, empty-input polling, or nonblocking-read failure is converted into status. Permanent starvation is excluded.

no_synthesis_or_cosim.method: Only csim_design exists in the build Tcl; no performance/RTL stages are defined.

T09.method: verify.trace_check plus exact output/status comparisons over all 55 retained operation traces. RESP_DONE is recorded after the generated response writer; PREAD is recorded immediately after the single-word sample reader. These observations are C execution order, not RTL timing.

fresh_streams.method: Source review: streams are local to each loop iteration, status is poisoned, and the kernel is called once. Unread input is captured after return; neither stream is reused for recovery.
